name: Paneer bhurji (scrambled paneer with onion and tomato)

source.name: Swasthi's Recipes (indianhealthyrecipes.com)
source.license: Ingredient amounts as listed in the cited recipe, converted to grams; nutrients composed from USDA FoodData Central (CC0)

notes: Serves 4. Weights: 1.5 tbsp oil = 20 g, 1/2 cup chopped onion = 80 g, 1/3 cup chopped tomato = 60 g, 1 green chilli = 5 g, 1 tsp ginger garlic paste split 2.5 g ginger + 2.5 g garlic, 1/2 tsp red chilli powder (low end). Garam masala as curry powder. Optional capsicum/peas, kasuri methi and lemon juice left out; coriander leaves (2 tbsp = 2 g) included. Assumed about 12% weight lost as steam from onion and tomato. A katori or bowl is taken as 1 cup, as everywhere in the catalog.
